caveat: One brand asks for benchmarking metrics while another, the same quarter, praises the built-in benchmarks. A discoverability failure on a working feature, not a missing capability.
source: Brand Value Stream: Getting Started, First 90 Days (Sept 2026)
statement: "Is this normal?" is the biggest unserved job for new brands: benchmarks exist in the product but the tier that needs them cannot find them.
